title: Count the R's
caption:
How many R's are in "strawberry"? Some AI chatbots have said 2.

AI doesn't read letters. It reads tokens, chunks of words like "str" + "aw" + "berry," so it never really sees each R. Know how it reads and you'll know where it slips.

Which word do you think would trip it up next?

"We asked an AI." Student: "How many R's are in 'strawberry'?" AI: "There are 2 R's in 'strawberry.'"
"Let's count." The three R tiles light up, numbered 1, 2, 3. Stamp: "It's 3."
"AI doesn't see letters. It sees tokens." The tiles split into three tokens: STR, AW, BERRY. "Tokens are chunks of words, like str + aw + berry. It never really sees each R."
"Know how it reads. Spot where it slips." Merc: "Want to find its other blind spots?"
